neighbours.label: an emphatic, hyperbolic word in an intensified run (all-caps THE, stacked insults, 'impossibly', repeated 'please')
fire: Honestly, this is hands down THE greatest pizza I have ever eaten.
The landlord is a vile, loathsome, contemptible little man.
The bride wore an impossibly elegant gown of ivory silk.
I am begging you, please, please, please call your mother.
Critics called her the unrivaled, unstoppable queen of pop.
That was the most breathtakingly stupid decision of the decade.
Our coach is an absolutely phenomenal, once-in-a-lifetime talent.
This is, without exaggeration, the single worst movie ever made.
quiet: Honestly, this is a good pizza and I would order it again.
The landlord is a quiet man who lives on the top floor.
The bride wore a long gown of ivory silk.
I am asking you to call your mother this weekend.
Critics called her a popular singer with a strong voice.
That was a poor decision by the city council.
Our coach has worked with the team for five years.
This is, in my view, a fairly average movie.
